rows.definition: internal/checkpointscore DebtKey: the sum of defects from probing each long-running subsystem for a durable resumable store (crash_recovery) and a witnessed status surface - readiness debt for surviving a checkpoint/restart.
rows.distinction: Counts missing DURABLE-RESUME/witnessed-status wiring per subsystem - NOT negation_tax_debt (reframable negation on the hot path) and NOT sota_debt (uncovered SOTA matrix rows).

rows.definition: internal/conceptcatalog + tools/concept_disambiguation_scorecard.py: the count of confusable tree tokens DISCOVERED in the corpus but not yet positioned by a disambiguation row - how much of the confusable namespace is unmapped.
rows.distinction: Counts UN-POSITIONED confusable concept tokens (a namespace-coverage gap) - NOT clarity_debt (verdict overclaims on rows that DO exist) and NOT weighted_debt (broadcast-weighted negation on the hot path).

rows.definition: internal/negframe/taxscore.go NegationTaxDebtKey: the FLAT headline count of reframable negation still broadcast on the hot path (the mechanical residual that survives each emit site's own reframe).
rows.distinction: The UNWEIGHTED headline negation count that gates - NOT weighted_debt (the same debt scaled by each surface's broadcast tier, used only to ORDER paydown) and NOT the advisory judgement total.

rows.definition: internal/negframe/hotpathdebt.go WeightedDebt: the sum of per-surface negation residual each scaled by the surface's broadcast tier - the #4408 ORDERING signal that sorts paydown worst (hottest-weighted) first.
rows.distinction: The TIER-WEIGHTED ordering total (does not gate) - NOT negation_tax_debt (the flat headline count that gates) and NOT checkpoint_debt (checkpoint-readiness defects).

rows.definition: internal/sotacoverage/sotacoverage.go SOTADebt: the count of unmet cells in the state-of-the-art coverage matrix - capabilities the repo claims to match SOTA on but has no passing witness for.
rows.distinction: Counts uncovered SOTA-MATRIX rows (capability parity gaps) - NOT coverage_debt (unpositioned concept tokens) and NOT negation_tax_debt (hot-path negation).
